interaction.prompt: The puck is in the corner and your teammate is on it. Your job is the forward parked in front of the net. Drag YOURSELF to the spot that keeps you between your check and the net.

feedback.right: Net-side and inside. You're between your check and the goalie with your stick in the lane, so the dangerous pass to the slot is taken away before it happens.
feedback.wrong: Drifting toward the puck leaves your check alone in front of the net. Stay on the defensive side, between your forward and the goalie, ready to defend the slot.

tip: Cover your own check first. Stay between them and the net, on the inside, even when the puck is somewhere else.
why: Young defenders chase the puck and lose their man at the net. Holding net-side position on your check takes away the most dangerous pass into the slot.

read.cue: check parked in front of net, puck in corner
